Every consumer evolves.
So should your marketing.

Webo Intent.The agentic platform built to turn intent into outcomes.

Webo Intent decodes billions of behavioral, contextual and semantic signals to understand what audiences want, and turns that intelligence into better data, dynamic audiences and full-funnel activation.

See Webo Intent in action

Intent at scale.

25 years of signal intelligence. Built for the intent era. One of Europe's largest signal ecosystems, combined with proprietary semantic AI,
data and media technology.

200M+
profiles

signals

From billions of signals to something
you can act on.

Webo Intent continuously turns changing consumer signals into intelligence you can use across data, audiences and activation.

DECODE
Understand what people want.

Behavioral, contextual, semantic and first-party signals reveal emerging needs, interests and demand.

SCORE
Measure intent as it changes.

Each profile gets a dynamic intent score that continuously evolves as new signals appear.

STRUCTURE
Turn intent into usable data.

Transform intent signals into dynamic audiences and actionable data for CRM, CDP and activation.

ACTIVATE
Turn intent into outcomes.

Use intent to guide targeting, channels, media pressure and optimisation across the full funnel.

CREATE
Bring activation to life with high-impact creative experiences.

Powered by our in-house technology, creative experiences enhance activation across the full funnel.
